## VIDEO 7632607461127539989 - "Vung trung binh"

**Slide 0:**
Nghe thuat vuot qua vung trung binh
Beyond the Learning Surface
inside learning | Marketing Academy

**Slide 1:**
Tu duy "Cuc doan co chu dich" (Strategic Extremism)

De thoat khoi muc trung binh, ban phai dam day mot thuoc tinh cua minh toi muc cuc dai.
- Trung binh: Lam noi dung vua co anh dep, vua co chu hay, vua co video. Ket qua: Moi thu deu nhat.
- Vuot nguong: Ban chon chi dung Su that tran trui. Ban dam dang nhung tam anh "xau", nhoe mo, khong filter nhung mang thong diep cuc gat.
- Bai hoc: Su trung binh den tu viec co gang lam hai long tat ca moi nguoi. Su kiet xuat den tu viec dam bi mot nhom nguoi ghet de duoc mot nhom nguoi khac ton tho.

**Slide 2:**
Stop being "Nice"

Dung co gang to ra de thuong. Hay co quan diem (Point of View) manh me. Mot y kien gay tranh cai luon tot hon mot y kien ma ai cung gat dau roi quen ngay.
Them mot yeu to "lech pha" vao san pham. Neu anh dang qua dep, hay viet mot cai caption that tho. Neu noi dung dang qua nghiem tuc, hay dung mot hinh anh vo tri.
Vung trung binh la noi nguoi ta giau di khiem khuyet. Su vuot nguong nam o cho ban bien khiem khuyet thanh dac diem nhan dang.

**Slide 3:**
Pha vo "Loi nguyen cua su chuyen nghiep"

Nhieu Marketer bi ket o vung trung binh vi ho qua "sach se". Ho noi nhung ngon tu chuan muc, dung bo cuc an toan.
- Nghe thuat: Hay dua vao do su "Song" (Rawness).
- Hay nhin bo anh cua ban: No vuot qua vung trung binh vi no khong "chuyen nghiep" theo kieu Agency. No "that" theo kieu mot nguoi ban dang ngoi tra da cung nhau.
- Bi quyet: Khi ai cung co gang deo mat na hoan hao, nguoi dam thao mat na ra dau tien chinh la nguoi dan dat.

**Slide 4:**
Ky thuat "Nen va Bung no" (The Compression Technique)

Vung trung binh thuong la su dan trai. De vuot qua, ban can nang luong cua su hoi tu.
- Nen: Thay vi noi 10 dieu tot ve ban than, hay nen tat ca vao mot gia tri duy nhat (vi du: "Nguoi noi that ve Marketing").
- Bung no: Dung moi kenh, moi hinh anh, moi truc giac de bao ve gia tri do.
- Khi ban tap trung toan bo "cong luc" vao mot diem nho, ban se xuyen thung duoc buc tuong cua su tho o tu khach hang.

**Slide 5:**
Vung trung binh la mot "cai chet em ai". Ban van co luong, van co Like, nhung ban khong co Di san. De vuot qua no, ban phai chap nhan cam giac co don cua mot nguoi di tien phong va vuot qua nguong an toan cua chinh minh.

---

## VIDEO 7633322312279903508 - "Marketing"

**Slide 0:**
Li do dang sau mot idea khong duoc duyet
Beyond the Learning Surface
inside learning | Marketing Academy

**Slide 1:**
Thieu su ket noi voi "Muc tieu kinh doanh"

Day la ly do pho bien nhat. Ban dua ra mot y tuong cuc ky "nghe", cuc ky "chua lanh", nhung sep/khach hang chi nhin thay: "No co ra so khong?".
- Van de: Ban dang dung Nao Phai (cam xuc) de ban hang cho mot nguoi dang dung Nao Trai (logic/con so).
- Giai phap: Hay boc idea cua ban trong mot lop vo "loi nhuan". Thay vi noi "Y tuong nay rat cam dong", hay noi "Y tuong nay danh vao noi dau X cua khach hang, tu do tang ty le chuyen doi them Y%".

**Slide 2:**
"Loi nguyen tri thuc" va Bias ca nhan

Ban hieu rat ro y tuong cua minh, nhung ban quen mat nguoi duyet idea khong o trong dau ban.
- Van de: Ban nhay thang den ket luan ma bo qua qua trinh dan dat. Idea cua ban bi dinh Self-serving bias (ban thay no hay vi no la cua ban).
- Giai phap: Dung ky thuat Zoom Out. Hay trinh bay idea nhu the ban dang ke chuyen cho mot nguoi la. Neu ho khong hieu trong 30 giay, y tuong do chua du sac.

**Slide 3:**
Y tuong qua "An toan" hoac qua "Cuc doan"

Qua an toan (Vung trung binh): Sep thay no nhat, khong co gi dot pha so voi doi thu.
Qua cuc doan (Pha Quan qua da): Ban muon dap bo moi thu nhung lai khong cho sep thay duoc cai "mong" moi se xay tren do la gi. Nguoi duyet luon so rui ro (Loss Aversion).
Giai phap: Dung cong thuc 70/30. 70% dua tren nhung gi da thanh cong (de tao su an tam) va 30% la su pha cach dien ro cua ban (de tao su dot pha).

**Slide 4:**
Sai thoi diem (Timing & Energy)

Trong chien luoc, dung viec nhung sai thoi diem van la sai.
- Van de: Ban de xuat mot chien dich chua lanh khi cong ty dang can doanh so gap de bu lo. Hoac ban de xuat mot y tuong "pha cach" khi sep dang o trang thai nang luong thap (muon on dinh).
- Giai phap: Doc vi nang luong cua nguoi duyet. Neu ho mang nang luong so 4 hoac so 7, ho can du lieu thuc te. Neu ho mang nang luong so 1, ho can su tien phong.

**Slide 5:**
Lan gan nhat y tuong cua ban bi tu choi, ly do ho dua ra (hoac ban cam nhan duoc) la gi?

---

## VIDEO 7633661100030004500 - "Nhay ben kinh doanh"

**Slide 0:**
Nghe Thuat Luyen Business Sense
inside learning | Beyond the Learning Surface
Ky thuat ZOOM IN: "Soi" den tung nguyen tu
Ky thuat ZOOM OUT: Nhin tu 10.000 met
Bai tap luyen tap: "Con mat dien anh"
Ket noi truc giac va Tam nhin

**Slide 1:**
Ky thuat ZOOM IN: "Soi" den tung nguyen tu

Day la kha nang quan sat vi mo, tim ra cai "cham" khien khach hang rung dong.
- Quan sat vet nut: Dung nhin mot cua hang dong khach, hay nhin xem khach hang nhiu may o giay thu may khi dung cho thanh toan. Do chinh la "diem dau" (Pain point) thuc te nhat.
- Giai phau ngon tu: Khi doc mot binh luan viral, hay Zoom In vao tu ngu ho dung. Tai sao tu do lai gay trigger den nguoi doc? Tu ngu nao da tao nen giong dieu cach ngat cau nay?

**Slide 2:**
Ky thuat ZOOM OUT: Nhin tu 10.000 met

Day la kha nang nhin vi mo, thay duoc su van hanh cua ca mot he sinh thai.
Ket noi cac diem (Connecting Dots): Khi thay gia xang tang, dung chi nghi ve tien xang. Hay Zoom Out:
Gia van chuyen tang -> Rau xanh tang -> Nguoi tre bot di an ngoai -> Ho se o nha luot mang nhieu hon -> Day la luc noi dung giai tri tai gia se len ngoi.

**Slide 3:**
Ket noi truc giac va Tam nhin

Truc giac thuong den tu Zoom In (cam nhan rung dong nho nhat), nhung no chi dung khi duoc kiem chung bang Zoom Out (dat vao boi canh lon).
- Neu ban chi Zoom In vao cai "Toi" cua minh, ban se bi Bias.
- Neu ban Zoom Out ra ca thi truong, ban se thay bai viet viral cua minh vua roi khong phai la ngau nhien. No la ket qua cua viec ban Zoom In vao tam su tham kin cua ca nhan nhung lai Zoom Out dung vao con khat su that cua cong dong.

**Slide 4:**
Lan toi khi ban di tren duong, hay thu nhin mot nguoi la va thuc hien quy trinh Zoom In - Zoom Out nay. Ban co the ke ve mot trai nghiem ung dung o duoi comment nhe!

---

## VIDEO 7634434190716456213 - (hashtag only)

**Slide 0:**
Nghe thuat nhin moi thu o goc do chien luoc
inside learning | Beyond the Learning Surface
3 tang luyen doi mat chien luoc

**Slide 1:**
Nhin moi thu o goc do chien luoc khong phai la nhin "nhieu hon", ma la nhin "xuyen qua". No la nghe thuat ket noi nhung diem roi rac thanh mot dong chay co chu dich.

**Slide 2:**
Tang Quan he Nhan - Qua (The Chain of Causality)

Nguoi lam chien luoc khong bao gio nhin mot su viec don le. Ho nhin no nhu mot mat xich.
Tu duy thong thuong: "Bai viet nay viral, minh nen lam them nhieu bai giong vay." (Nhin vao phan ngon).
Tu duy chien luoc: "Tai sao no viral luc nay? No dang danh vao tam ly thieu an toan cua dam dong hay su khao khat tinh ban ban nguyen? Neu minh lap lai, lieu gia tri thuong hieu co bi pha loang khong hay se tao ra mot dinh vi moi?"
- Ky thuat: Luon hoi "Va roi sao nua?" (And then what?). Moi hanh dong hom nay la quan co do cho ket qua cua 6 thang toi.

**Slide 3:**
Tang Cau truc He sinh thai (The Ecosystem View)

Nhin moi thu o goc do chien luoc la hieu rang khong co gi ton tai doc lap. Mot chien dich Marketing thanh cong la su cong huong cua: Boi canh xa hoi + Nang luc loi cua ban + Noi dau cua khach hang.
- Zoom Out: Dung chi nhin vao Threads hay TikTok. Hay nhin vao nen kinh te vi mo. Khi tui tien cua nguoi dan hep lai, ho se "mua" su an ui.
- Dinh vi (Positioning): Chien luoc la chon khong lam gi. Ban khong the vua re, vua sang, vua nhanh. Nhin chien luoc la nhin ra "diem ngot" (Sweet Spot): Noi ban gioi nhat, doi thu yeu nhat va khach hang can nhat.

**Slide 4:**
Ky thuat luyen tap: "Ban do 3 lop"

Moi khi tiep can mot van de (Vi du: Sep yeu cau tang 20% doanh so thang toi), hay nhin qua 3 lop:
1. Lop Be mat (Thuc thi): Chay Ads, khuyen mai, viet Content. (Day la cach ton suc nhat).
2. Lop Cau truc (Chien thuat): Thay doi pheu ban hang, toi uu hoa ty le chuyen doi, su dung AI de giam chi phi.
3. Lop Goc re (Chien luoc): Thay doi loi hua thuong hieu, tim mot ngach thi truong moi ma doi thu chua cham toi, hoac bien khach hang thanh nguoi ham mo trung thanh bang su chua lanh.

**Slide 5:**
Hay thu ap dung goc nhin chien luoc nay de len ke hoach cho "buoc di tiep theo" cua ban.
